Full.description: 100 forge + 100 claudecode raw conversation traces with full embedded raw payload

Lite.description: 2 forge + 2 claudecode curated subset for quick iteration and smoke tests
Lite.use_case: Quick smoke / CI gate / development iteration

schema.conversation_id: Unique session identifier from source DB
schema.title: Conversation title or first user prompt excerpt
schema.duration_seconds: Wall-clock duration of the session in seconds
schema.tool_count: Total tool invocations across the session
schema.user_intent: Derived high-level intent (may be empty for short traces)
schema.is_human_driven: True if parent_id is null (top-level human-initiated)
schema.is_long_horizon: True if duration exceeds long-horizon threshold (multi-day or 100+ tools)
schema.model: Primary model used in the session
schema.raw: Full conversation payload (JSON-encoded, may contain nested message structure)

selection_criteria.long_vs_short: Mix of multi-day long-horizon traces and short single-task traces
selection_criteria.raw_fidelity: raw column preserves full conversation payload with no removals
selection_criteria.structure: Schema chosen for direct ingest by AI-DD eval runner without additional processing
